items.title: Mozambique: Chigamane golf project breaks ground as Inhambane swings onto the global golf tourism stage
items.summary: The initiative was announced by the Presidency following a ceremony in Chigamane, a locality in the tourist district of Vilankulo, Inhambane province, where Mozambican President Daniel Chapo laid the foundation stone for the construction of the golf courses In a statement, the Presidency said the development represents an investment in diversifying Vilankulo’s tourism offer, seeking to strengthen the district’s ability to attract visitors and consolidate its position as a leading destination in national and international tourism markets The initiative aims to attract tourists from various regions of Mozambique and countries such as South Africa, Zimbabwe, Tanzania and Zambia, thereby laying the groundwork for local economic growth, business development and greater participation by national operators in the tourism value chain,” the statement said The Chigamane golf project forms part of the broader strategy adopted by the Government to develop golf tourism in Inhambane province.

items.title: Israel: Eisenkot officially tasked with forming a government
items.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasked Gadi Eisenkot with the right of trying to form a government. The opposition leader's way to replacing Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister is full of political challenges Israel President Isaac Herzog has officially tasked Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government Eisenkot, the head of the centrist Yashar party, will have 28 days to secure a coalition to replace current Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu 's religious-nationalist government, with Herzog having the authority to prolong Eisenkot's mandate by 14 days "The conversations with the different parties were open and transparent, while also resurfacing the many voices in Israeli society. They reminded us the fact that all Israeli citizens have an equal voice, from all parts of society," Herzog said He stressed that Eisenkot received the clearest support from the majority of Knesset members when it comes to the question of forming the next government "The challenges we face are giant. Iran is not waiting a second in its threats.

items.title: EUMAM MOZ supports Lar Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados with essential supplies
items.summary: The initiative was attended by the EUMAM MOZ Force Commander, Brigadier General Sérgio Estrela, who, accompanied by Mission personnel, visited both the female and male residential wards of the care home. Beyond the delivery of the donated items, the visit provided opportunities for interaction and engagement with the residents in an atmosphere of fellowship and sharing, enabling Mission personnel to gain a better understanding of the realities and challenges faced by this community Photo: European Union Military Assistance Mission in Mozambique The Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados Care Home carries out valuable social assistance work that requires a continuous response to the needs of its residents.

items.title: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections
items.summary: Near-final results show South Africa's once dominant ANC will see its lowest-ever vote percentage. The party is taking the blame for shoddy municipal services, including water and electricity shortages South Africa's African National Congress (ANC) is heading for an historically poor election performance , with the near-final tally from Wednesday's municipal polls showing it coming in with just over 30% of the vote The ANC also lost its majority in six of the eight metropolitan regions, South Africa's Electoral Commission said Saturday in sharing the results after 98% of votes were counted South African voters in 2026 are angry about water and electricity shortages, with the ANC taking the blame for the poor state of municipalities. High unemployment, crime, and widespread corruption are other pressing issues ANC leader, and South African president, Cyril Ramaphosa , has not yet addressed the poor performance as of Saturday evening.
